business_summary: The Zenitaka Corporation provides general contracting services in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the planning, designing, and execution of construction activities; urban, suburban, and marine development operations; real estate; and engineering activities, as well as civil engineering and architect businesses. The company was founded in 1705 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Zenitaka Corporation은 일본 및 국제적으로 종합 계약 서비스를 제공합니다. 건설 활동의 계획, 설계 및 실행에 참여합니다. 도시, 교외 및 해양 개발 작업; 부동산; 토목사업, 건축사업은 물론 엔지니어링 활동까지. 이 회사는 1705년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
